notes.title: Update 1.2: Endless Mode
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257157/a50da458f0d012032fafeed25c8577082e27588e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Greetings, Necrotypers![/b][/p][p]Update 1.2 comes with a heap of bug fixes and improvements, and also introduces two new Endless levels. Survive waves of enemies by building defensive structures. After each wave, you are rewarded with a perk that further increases your power. Levels can be accessed on the world map once you’ve progressed far enough into the game.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube=QwNoy2m5Cn8;full][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]🛡️ [b]Endless Mode[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Added a new [b]Endless Mode[/b], where you fend off waves of enemies.
[/p][/*][*][p] Buy towers, earn perks, and survive for as long as possible.
[/p][/*][*][p] Two Endless levels have been added to the map. They unlock once you've progressed far enough in the game. Try to survive as many waves as you can!
[/p][/*][/list][p]
📖 [b]Spellbook Improvements[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Spell descriptions are now more detailed.
[/p][/*][*][p] Spells that summon skeletons now display the stats of those skeletons.
[/p][/*][*][p] Items previously listed in the spellbook's Item section have been moved under their respective skeleton units.
[/p][/*][*][p] Various UI and UX tweaks.
[/p][/*][*][p] Numerous gameplay bug fixes.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes & Other Improvements[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where the [b]Perfectionist[/b] achievement sometimes wouldn’t be detected (applies to older save games as well).
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved skeleton formation logic.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issues with overlapping text.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved intro and outro cutscenes.
[/p][/*][*][p] Enhanced combat sound effects.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved UX when discovering new items.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Difficulty modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Difficulty of the level can now be selected on the world map.
[*] Difficulty level now impacts not only the length of words, but also how much focus you lose on a mistype and the spawn rate of enemies.
[/list]

[b]Misc. Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased damage and armor penetration for higher-tier ranged weapons.
[*]Significantly reduced the cost of all spell upgrades.
[*]Spell book page buttons now appear when previous or next pages are available.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Significant performance improvements in certain levels by adjusting foliage quality and density.
[*]Replaced grass for better performance and visual quality.
[*]Automatic quality detection when first starting the game.
[*]Quality settings should now save correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue in the "Toll House" level where a tutorial window would get stuck and prevent the player from progressing.
[*]Added missing icons and names for items.
[*]Fixed a bug where skeletons would get stuck on the siege tower.
[*]Fixed a bug where Crush spell visual effect would remain once triggered.
[*]Fixed a soul counter at the top of the spellbook.
[*]Fixed an issue on macOS, where directional keys would be detected as letter input.
[*]Creating a new save game profile now immediately selects it.
[*]Fixed a bug in cinematics, where text writing would ignore the last letter.
[/list]
